name: account
definition: 由金融机构开立、用于记录客户资金往来与余额的记账单元，具有唯一编号、所属地区和账单出具频率等特征。 Counterexample: 与「银行卡」辨析：银行卡是账户的访问凭证，一个账户可对应多张卡；与「贷款」辨析：贷款是账户下的一类资金业务，不是账户本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table account; provenance: direct source account

name: district
definition: 具有唯一编号和一组人口、行政区划统计特征的行政地理区域，是客户与账户归属的空间单元。 Counterexample: 与「地址」辨析：地址是描述具体位置的文本信息，地区是用于统计与归属划分的行政单元；与「网点」辨析：网点是办理业务的机构实体，地区是地理划分。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table district; provenance: direct source district

name: client
definition: 在金融机构登记注册、具有性别与出生日期等个人属性并归属某一地区的自然人主体。 Counterexample: 与「账户持有人」辨析：账户持有人是账户关系中的角色，客户是独立登记的主体，一个客户可持有多个账户；与「员工」辨析：员工是机构内部人员，客户是外部服务对象。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table client; provenance: direct source client

name: disp
definition: 记录某一客户对某一账户所拥有的支配权限及其类型的关联条目，具有唯一编号并连接客户与账户。 Counterexample: 与「账户」辨析：账户是资金记账单元，支配关系是客户与账户之间的权限连接；与「交易」辨析：交易是资金变动事件，支配关系是静态权限记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table disp; provenance: direct source disp

name: card
definition: 由金融机构发行、绑定到某一账户支配关系上、具有卡类型和发卡日期的支付凭证。 Counterexample: 与「账户」辨析：账户是资金记账单元，卡是访问账户的物理或电子凭证；与「信用卡」辨析：信用卡是卡的一种类型，不能与卡整体等同。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table card; provenance: direct source card

name: loan
definition: 金融机构向账户发放的、具有金额、期限、还款安排和状态等特征的信贷资金业务。 Counterexample: 与「账户」辨析：账户是资金记账单元，贷款是账户下的一类信贷业务；与「交易」辨析：交易是资金变动事件，贷款是具有持续期限的信贷合约。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table loan; provenance: direct source loan

name: order
definition: 由某一账户发起、指定收款银行与收款账号并载明金额和用途的汇款指令记录。 Counterexample: 与「交易」辨析：交易是已发生的资金变动事件，汇款指令是发起汇款的请求记录；与「贷款」辨析：贷款是信贷合约，汇款指令是资金划转请求。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table order; provenance: direct source order

name: trans
definition: 在某一账户上发生的、具有日期、类型、操作、金额和余额等特征的资金变动事件。 Counterexample: 与「账户」辨析：账户是资金记账单元，交易是账户上发生的资金变动事件；与「汇款指令」辨析：汇款指令是请求记录，交易是实际发生的资金变动。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table trans; provenance: direct source trans

name: WeeklyStatement
definition: Account whose statement frequency is weekly issuance.

name: MonthlyStatement
definition: Account whose statement frequency is monthly issuance.

name: AfterTransactionStatement
definition: Account whose statement is issued after transaction.
scope: account where frequency IN ('POPLATEK PO OBRATU')

name: AccountOpeningDate
definition: Date on which the account was opened.

name: DistrictName
definition: Name of the district where the client or account is located.

name: Region
definition: Region of the district.

name: AverageSalary
definition: Average salary in the district.

name: ClientGender
definition: Gender of the client.

name: ClientBirthDate
definition: Birth date of the client.

name: LoanApprovedAmount
definition: Amount of the approved loan.

name: LoanApprovedDate
definition: Date on which the loan was approved.

name: LoanDuration
definition: Duration of the loan in months.

name: LoanStatus
definition: Status of the loan contract.

name: CashWithdrawal
definition: Transaction operation representing a cash withdrawal.

name: ClientId
definition: Unique identifier of the client.

name: PercentageOfRunningLoans
definition: Percentage of loan amount for accounts with running status among all loans. Formula: (SUM(LoanApprovedAmount WHERE LoanStatus = 'C') / SUM(LoanApprovedAmount)) * 100. Inputs: LoanApprovedAmount = loan.amount; LoanStatus = loan.status
aliases: percentage of accounts with no issue

name: PercentageOfMaleClientsRequestingWeeklyStatements
definition: Percentage of male clients among clients who requested weekly statements. Formula: (COUNT(DISTINCT ClientId WHERE ClientGender = 'M' AND WeeklyStatement) / COUNT(DISTINCT ClientId WHERE WeeklyStatement)) * 100. Inputs: ClientId = client.client_id; ClientGender = client.gender; WeeklyStatement = account.frequency WHERE frequency IN ('POPLATEK TYDNE')
aliases: percentage of male clients requesting weekly statements

name: PercentageOfWomenInHighSalaryDistricts
definition: Percentage of female clients among clients in districts with average salary over 10000. Formula: (COUNT(DISTINCT ClientId WHERE ClientGender = 'F' AND AverageSalary > 10000) / COUNT(DISTINCT ClientId WHERE AverageSalary > 10000)) * 100. Inputs: ClientId = client.client_id; ClientGender = client.gender; AverageSalary = district.A11
aliases: percentage of women in districts with average salary over 10
percentage of women in high salary districts

name: AverageLoanAmountPerAccount
definition: Average loan amount per account. Formula: SUM(LoanApprovedAmount) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id). Inputs: LoanApprovedAmount = loan.amount

name: LoanCountPerAccount
definition: Number of loans per account. Formula: COUNT(loan_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id). Inputs: LoanApprovedAmount = loan.amount

name: TotalLoanAmount
definition: Total amount of approved loans. Formula: SUM(LoanApprovedAmount). Inputs: LoanApprovedAmount = loan.amount

name: TotalWithdrawalAmount
definition: Total amount of cash withdrawals. Formula: SUM(amount WHERE CashWithdrawal). Inputs: CashWithdrawal = trans.operation WHERE operation IN ('VYBER')

name: ClientCountByRegion
definition: Number of clients in each region. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT ClientId) GROUP BY Region. Inputs: ClientId = client.client_id; Region = district.A3

name: AccountCountByFrequency
definition: Number of accounts for each statement frequency. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) GROUP BY frequency. Inputs: WeeklyStatement = account.frequency WHERE frequency IN ('POPLATEK TYDNE'); MonthlyStatement = account.frequency WHERE frequency IN ('POPLATEK MESICNE'); AfterTransactionStatement = account.frequency WHERE frequency IN ('POPLATEK PO OBRATU')
aliases: number of accounts by statement frequency

name: LoanAmountPercentageByStatus
definition: Percentage of total loan amount for each loan status. Formula: (SUM(LoanApprovedAmount) GROUP BY LoanStatus / SUM(LoanApprovedAmount)) * 100. Inputs: LoanApprovedAmount = loan.amount; LoanStatus = loan.status
aliases: percentage of loan amount by status

definition: Analysis of account statement issuance frequency types.

name: LoanStatus
definition: Analysis of loan contract statuses.

name: TransactionOperation
definition: Analysis of transaction operation types.

name: TransactionType
definition: Analysis of transaction types.

name: TransactionKSymbol
definition: Analysis of transaction k_symbol categories.

name: OrderKSymbol
definition: Analysis of order k_symbol categories.

name: DispType
definition: Analysis of disposition types.
